description: Returns the full site index - every VertoDigital page's URL and a one-line description, source of the valid slugs used by vertodigital_get_page. Read-only, no side effects, reflects the live /llms.txt index.

section.description: Optional section heading to filter to, e.g. "Services", "Case studies", "Content Hub", "Industries". Matched case-insensitively against the index's section headings. Omit to return the full index.

name: vertodigital_get_site_index

markdown.description: The document as markdown - identical to the text content block.

section.description: The section filter that was requested, or null for the full index

section_found.description: True when the requested section matched a heading; false when it did not and the full index was returned instead
